regions.merged_text: course, to the generous activity on our behalf of, quite a num- ber of our personal friends in arranging the affair, conducted on our behalf in the Naval Armory this evening at O'clock, and so enthusiastically seconded by the public in general on both sides of the Detroit River. What I want to stress To-day is the importance these days of appreciation for favors -- on our part; that we be grateful for such enthusiasm -- grateful to God first for such friends' and then to the friends themselves; for in my humble conviction APPRECIATION with its synonum GRATITUDE IS as necessary for social order and harmony as are the laws of gravity for the physical order of inanimate beings. ONCE more, therefore, let me thank you my brethren, one and all, in the name of our Capuchin Community. May mutual appreciation be the soul of our relationship in the future as this affair in the Armory seems to prove it has been in the past. God Bless You All.
